This document has two parts: **Part A, the Privacy Policy** (what personal data we collect, why, who we share it with and your rights) and **Part B, the Terms of Use** (the rules for using our services). Both apply to all three of our services listed above.

| **Service** | **What it is** |
|---|---|
| Picaffectz Studio studio.picaffectz.com | Our website builder and content system. Picaffectz staff, and clients we invite, sign in to create, edit, publish and manage websites. |
| Design Yourself diy.picaffectz.com | A free tool where anyone can describe their business, upload details, and see an AI-assisted preview of a website, then send it to us to build. |
| Picaffectz Themes themes.picaffectz.com | A public gallery of our website themes and layouts, which can be previewed and chosen for a new website. |

## Part A: Privacy Policy

## 1. Who we are

These services are run by **Picaffectz**, India (“**Picaffectz**”, “**we**”, “**us**”). For the personal data described in this policy, we are the **Data Fiduciary** under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (the “**DPDP Act**”) and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025.

Contact for anything in this policy: **picaffectz@gmail.om** · **9989241693**.

## 2. What this policy covers

This policy covers personal data we collect through Picaffectz Studio, Design Yourself and Picaffectz Themes, and through emails and messages connected with them.

It does **not** cover the websites we build for our clients. On a client's website, the client decides what is collected from its visitors and customers (for example enquiries, orders and bookings) and is responsible for it under its own privacy policy. We host and run those websites for the client and handle that data only on the client's instructions, as their processor.

## 3. What we collect

| **Where** | **What we collect** | **How we get it** |
|---|---|---|
| Design Yourself | Your email address (confirmed with a one-time code); your name and, if you choose, phone or WhatsApp number and a note; the answers you give about your business (name, type of business, what you offer, location, contact details, opening hours, and similar); files you upload (PDF, Word, Excel, text files, photos, logos); the website preview created for you. | From you, when you use the page and when you press “Send to Picaffectz”. |
| Picaffectz Studio | Your name, email address and role; sign-in details (one-time email codes, a PIN if you set one, or your Google account's name and email if you sign in with Google); the content, photos and files you add to projects; comments and approvals on designs; settings and preferences. | From you, from the person who invited you, and from Google if you choose Google sign-in. |
| Picaffectz Themes | No account or form. Only the technical data below, and choices remembered in your own browser. | From your browser. |
| All services | Technical data: IP address, browser and device type, pages requested, date and time, and error and security logs. | Automatically, from your browser and our hosting provider. |

We do not ask for sensitive information such as health, financial account or card details, or government ID numbers through these services. Please don't upload documents that contain them.

## 4. Why we use it

​• **To give you the service:** to make your website preview, read your uploaded files into it, keep your work, sign you in and let you manage projects.

​• **To answer your request:** when you send a design to us, to contact you about building and publishing your website, its price and next steps.

​• **To confirm it's you:** one-time codes by email to check your email address and to sign you in.

​• **To send service emails:** codes, confirmations, and messages about your request or project. We do not send marketing emails unless you have agreed to them, and you can stop them at any time.

​• **To keep the services secure and working:** preventing spam and abuse, fixing faults, and keeping logs.

​• **To meet legal duties:** for example tax records, or a lawful request from an authority.

We process your personal data on the basis of your **consent**, which you give when you use a service and send us your details, and for the **legitimate uses** the DPDP Act allows, such as meeting a legal obligation. You can withdraw consent at any time (section 9). Withdrawing does not affect what was done before, but we may then be unable to continue the service.

## 5. AI and automated processing

Design Yourself and some Studio tools use artificial intelligence to write website text, read uploaded documents and pictures, suggest designs, and create images. To do this, the text and files you provide are sent to an AI service: Cloudflare Workers AI, or an AI provider we have chosen, such as Claude / Gemini. Some reading of documents happens on your own device, in your browser.

We use these services only to produce your result. We do not use your content to train our own AI models, and we choose provider settings that do not use your data for training where the provider offers that choice. AI output can be wrong: please check everything before it is published. No decision with legal or similarly significant effects on you is made by automated means alone.

When you ask for stock photos, the search words (not your personal data) are sent to Unsplash.

## 6. Who we share it with

We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers who help us run the services, under contracts or terms that require them to protect it, and only as much as they need:

| **Provider** | **What for** |
|---|---|
| Cloudflare, Inc. | Hosting, database and file storage, security, and AI processing (Workers AI). |
| Resend | Sending emails such as one-time codes and confirmations. |
| Google LLC | Sign-in with Google (only if you choose it) and web fonts. |
| AI providers | Writing, reading and image creation, as described in section 5: Splash/Gemini/Picaffectz. |
| GitHub, Netlify | Storing and publishing website files, for projects published there. |
| Unsplash | Stock photo search (search words only). |
| Meta (WhatsApp), MSG91 or Twilio | Messages and codes by WhatsApp or SMS, only where switched on. |

We may also share personal data when the law requires it, to protect our rights or the safety of others, or with a buyer if our business is transferred (who must keep this policy's protections).

## 7. Where your data is stored

Our providers run data centres around the world, so your personal data may be stored or processed outside India, including in the United States and the European Union. We transfer data only to countries the Government of India has not restricted under the DPDP Act, and only to providers that protect it.

## 8. How long we keep it

​• **Design Yourself previews and requests:** for as long as we are discussing or building your website, and then for 3 months so we can pick up where we left off, unless you ask us to delete them sooner.

​• **Studio accounts and projects:** while the account or project is active, and then for decided time after it is closed, except where we have agreed otherwise with the client.

​• **One-time codes:** until used or expired (minutes).

​• **Technical and security logs:** usually up to decided time, longer if needed to investigate a security problem.

​• **Invoices and business records:** as long as tax and company law require (generally 8 years in India).

When personal data is no longer needed, we delete it or make it anonymous.

## 9. Your rights

Under the DPDP Act you have the right to:

​• get a summary of the personal data we hold about you and how we use it, and the names of those we have shared it with;

​• have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected or completed, and out-of-date data updated;

​• have your data erased when it is no longer needed for the purpose you gave it for, or when you withdraw consent (unless the law requires us to keep it);

​• withdraw your consent at any time, as easily as you gave it;

​• nominate another person to exercise these rights for you if you die or become unable to; and

​• have a grievance about how we handle your data addressed.

To use any of these rights, write to picaffectz@gmail.com from the email address you used with us. We may need to confirm your identity first. We will reply within limited time. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you may complain to the **Data Protection Board of India**.

## 11. Cookies and storage in your browser

We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. The services use your browser's local storage, and a small number of strictly necessary cookies, to:

​• keep you signed in to the Studio;

​• remember choices such as the website type you picked, your draft on Design Yourself, layout and display preferences, and whether you have seen the help tour; and

​• protect the services from abuse (our hosting provider, Cloudflare, may set its own security cookies).

These are needed for the services to work and are not used to track you across other sites. You can clear them in your browser settings at any time; you may then have to sign in again
